 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Sparse single-cell components are placement markers; the connected
    # multicolour/solid figure is the pattern to replicate.
    markers = []
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        unseen = set(cells)
        comps = []
        while unseen:
            start = unseen.pop()
            comp = [start]
            stack = [start]
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if p in unseen:
                        unseen.remove(p)
                        stack.append(p)
                        comp.append(p)
            comps.append(comp)
        singles = [comp[0] for comp in comps if len(comp) == 1]
        if len(singles) >= 2:
            markers.append((len(singles), color, singles))
    if not markers:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, marker_color, points = max(markers)
    pattern = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker_color]
    if not pattern:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r,c,v in pattern); r1 = max(r for r,c,v in pattern)
    c0 = min(c for r,c,v in pattern); c1 = max(c for r,c,v in pattern)
    cr = (r0 + r1) // 2; cc = (c0 + c1) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for pr, pc, color in pattern:
        for mr, mc in points:
            rr, col = mr + pr - cr, mc + pc - cc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                out[rr][col] = color
    return out
"
}
